photos.title: Woods cleared for new streets and house lots outside the city limits in Horry County, from above
photos.what: Straight down on 2023 NAIP imagery of unincorporated Horry County between Conway and North Myrtle Beach: two new subdivisions cut out of pine woods on either side of a two-lane road. Above the road, a loop of new paved street around a pond, with bare graded lots and no houses yet. Below the road, streets and ponds still being graded, with machines and sand piles. Older houses on large wooded lots at the upper left, farm ponds at the lower left, woods all around.
photos.caption: Woods cleared for new streets and house lots outside the city limits, between Conway and North Myrtle Beach.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of two new subdivisions being cut out of pine woods: a paved street loop around a pond with empty lots, and more streets being graded across the road

place.sublocation: Unincorporated Horry County between Conway and North Myrtle Beach (tax district 100, outside any city or town)
